blocks.text: 140 Musaph for the New Year 140

through the stormy sound of the Shofar. For those who know Him, there is comfort, it is reckoned a good sign for the establishment of peace through the pleasant sound of the Shofar. They who reject Him will be cut down, the faithless will be uprooted, rebels will sink down through the powerful sound of the Shofar. It sounds long drawn-out blasts and then short sharp notes, Teruah and Tekiah are included in the threefold sound of the Shofar. It spreads fear, shakes nations so that they speak of flight from the menacing sound of the Shofar. It tears down walls and makes an end of wars, like the roaring of the waves is the roaring sound of the Shofar. When the Lord revealed His will to His own people on Mount Sinai, the Revelation concluded with the long drawn out sound of the Shofar. When once the secret of redemption will be revealed to those exalted, jubilation and rejoicing He will proclaim through the sound of the Shofar. blocks.text: 141 Musaph for the New Year 141

Shofar. Sins are annulled and slavery is lifted and works are restored through the embracing sound of the Shofar. Destroy and cast away the realm of Seir, remember its transgression at the reverberating sound of the Shofar. Let the gates of the city sink and disappear, let fright overcome great and small at the roaring sound of the Shofar. Threefold miraculous signs, three hundred horns set up a loud lament in Midian at the accompanying sound of the Shofar. Israel's hosts rejoiced at witnessing the miracles when the Creator showed His might through the sweet sound of the Shofar. A slender voice descended upon earth, there were threefold sounds of thunder at the Revelation when sounds were given on the Shofar. A threefold sound of the horn will I blow this day as a symbol of the threefold call of the Shofar (at the redemption) that will one day resound from the future Shofar. I pray to heaven and my eyes are lifted up that I may be allowed to see the gathering of the exiles at the loud sound of the Shofar.
uncertainties: 'redemp-/tion' is a wrap hyphen and has been removed.

blocks.text: צר Fasten Thy laws to me lest they fly away like the eagle, lest there take flight those who make heard Thy voice. I will learn the pure law with my eyes on my Teacher just as once His messenger (Moses) spoke and God answered him with His voice.
ככתוב As it is written in Thy Torah: 'And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud'.

קרב The end has approached, the time of judgment comes, a defender arises to entreat with his voice. The new moon is sanctified and the feast prepared, so let me blow the Shofar that He may answer me with His voice.
ככתוב As it is written in Thy holy words: 'Blow the Shofar on the new moon, when the moon is covered on the day of our festival, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob'.

blocks.text: 142 Musaph for the New Year 142

The fourth of the wild beasts (that Daniel saw) will fall into the fire, among the sparking flames at the fiery sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt stir up sleep to pay retribution to the oppressor, and shatter his multitudes with the mighty sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt free the Rose (Israel) and let redemption dawn, revive those who slumber with the rousing sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt march from Hermon to destroy Admon, bring cooling to Tsalmon with the massive sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt step in our midst as once in the wilderness when Thou didst give us the Torah and once again wilt Thou allow to be heard in the Sanctuary a voice that sounds like that of the Shofar.

And it was said: 'And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance'.
